title: An introduction should make the next conversation easier
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Name the connection — Explain the shared question and relevant experience.; Check consent — Confirm availability and permission to share context.; Scope the first ask — Make the initial request clear and proportionate.; Hand over the conversation — Let both people choose the next step..
